jobs.occupation: Head of PS Division Incident Management (f/m/d) (Leiter/in - Risikomanagement)
jobs.description:
At TÜV SÜD Group, we are passionate about technology. Innovations shape our lives in many different ways, and at TÜV SÜD Group, we are highly committed to playing an active role in this progress. We test, we certify, we inspect, and we advise. We challenge ourselves every day to help ensure the safety of people and society. We live technology. We strive for professional excellence. We make an impact. We take the future into our own hands. We are TÜV SÜD Group.

The PS Division Incident Management Department plays a critical role in our business by ensuring that operational disruptions are identified,  managed, and resolved swiftly and effectively, safeguarding service continuity in a highly regulated environment. It is a key differentiator,
demonstrating our ability to meet stringent compliance requirements while maintaining trust with clients and regulators. Beyond reactive response, it enables proactive issue identification and mitigation, strengthening our “license to operate” by reducing risk exposure and
ensuring accountability. Furthermore, robust incident management minimizes the likelihood and impact of service failures, helping protect the organization from financial losses, reputational damage, and potential damage claims.

Leadership Tasks:

- Work with the current Head of PS Incident Management to lead &
develop of a central team to:
o manage serious incidents/ complaints/ claims in regard to PS
business globally
o to protect the TÜV SÜD brand in regard to the use of
certification marks under PS division
o coordinate global quality assurance activities such as
comparison tests for high-risk products as preventive action
to avoid future incidents
- To take over the position of Head of PS Division Incident
Management by Mid-2027 and ensure a proper handover of
leadership

Tasks of the PS Incident Management in relation to risk
management and damage claims:

- Develop and coordinate strategies to defend PS Division against
unjustified damage claims and reduce legitimate claims to the
extent of the fault
- Coordination of the investigation of serious incidents/ complaints/
deviations or claims (processes and technical issues) with
complaint managers located in the operations worldwide according
to the global PS Division Incident Management Procedure
- Risk assessment and risk reporting to the management
- Manage activities and coordination with external legal counsel as
corporate legal department at TÜV SÜD
- Support PS certification bodies and coordination of communication
with accreditation bodies and supervisory authorities (e.g. in case
of hearing letters and withdrawal of licenses proceedings)
- Coordinate with PS Quality Management to provide input on
improvements based on analysis of incidents/ complaints/
deviations or claims
- Support of operational departments in high-risk projects

Tasks of PS Incident Management in relation to risk management
and damage claims:

- Implementation and maintenance of EU border seizure procedures
according to EU Regulation 608/2013 für TÜV SÜD Product
Service trademarks
- Trade fair inspections in cooperation with customs/criminal
investigators and TÜV Markenverbund e.V.
- Provide anti-counterfeiting training in relation to TÜV SÜD and TÜV
SÜD Product Service marks
- Prosecution of trademark infringements and forgery of certificates,
test reports or licenses in cooperation with certification bodies
- Manage cease-and-desist letters to enforce claims regarding
misuse of TÜV SÜD brand/ marks in relation to Product Service
issues

Tasks of the PS Incident Management in relation to Quality
Assurance:

- Identify high risk products within the testing and certification scope
in the field of Product Service which could cause future incidents/
complaints/ deviations or claims
- Coordinate global quality assurance activities such as elected
comparison tests for high-risk products detected by the risk radar
system
- Analyse the results in close cooperation with technical experts and
Quality Management to determine preventive actions.

Qualification:

- Technical or legal degree
- Strong comprehension skills – especially in technical matters
- Solid legal knowledge - especially in contract law, trademark law,
procedural law, and the German Product Safety Act (ProdSG) and
Medical Devices Regulation (MDR)
- Expert-level knowledge in the areas of accreditation and
certification of consumer, commercial and medical devices
- Resilience, perseverance, assertiveness, and a hands-on
approach
- Flexibility and the ability to quickly grasp complex issues
- Risk Awareness
- Excellent oral and written communication skills in English and
German due to communication with accreditors and market
surveillance authorities as well as law enforcement authorities.
Aditional language skills are welcome

At TÜV SÜD Group, people from more than 100 nations work together – people with different backgrounds, skills and goals. Our strength lies in these many diverse perspectives.

We are committed to being an inclusive and diverse employer by welcoming everyone. Diversity and inclusion are the foundation of our company, and we foster an environment in which all our employees can trust that they will be treated with respect – regardless of age, nationality, ethnic background, disability, gender and gender identity, sexual orientation, religion or belief.

We expect all our employees to conduct themselves at all times in accordance with the TÜV SÜD Group Code of Ethics and our corporate values.

We firmly believe that consistently embedding these values will continue to make a significant contribution to the success of TÜV SÜD Group.

jobs.occupation: Working Student for Engineering - Transformation and Change Management (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the Engineering department, Airbus Helicopters is looking for a

Working Student for Engineering - Transformation and Change Management (d/f/m)

You are a full time student (d/f/m), looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of an Engineering Change Manager (d//f/m)?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Engineering department as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Donauwörth
- Start: as soon as possible
- Duration: 24 months

Join us as a working student (d/f/m) in Engineering to actively support our transformation and change towards the Engineering of tomorrow. This role offers an exciting opportunity to support the top management and prepare our engineering for the future by implementing the latest design tools (incl. AI) in an international environment, contributing to the continuous improvement and evolution of our exciting products. In your job you will be able to bring in your creative solutions. You will be coached by experienced experts and top management of our company.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

At our Donauwörth site, located on the banks of the river Danube, we develop helicopters from the initial idea to the airworthy product. Watch them take off and touch down on our own on-site test airfield.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation.
- Partial mobile working after agreement with the department.
- Traveling within Europe (team events) is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Assist in Transformation and Change projects for an international engineering function.
- Assist in the creation, preparation, documentation of workshops, events and roadshows for the leadership team and the engineering teams.
- Support the communication to the teams with creative formats (e.g. podcasts,...).
- Contribute to analyzing the effectiveness of the transformation initatives and identify gaps.
- Support the creation of inspiring presentations.
- Support in operative and administrative tasks.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled as a full-time student (d/f/m) in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering and Management, Work & Organizational Psychology, Human Resource, or a comparable degree program.
- Knowledge of—and ideally experience with—G Suite applications and Artificial Intelligence.
- Ideally, knowledge of and experience with Change Management.
- Strong interest in digital technologies and their application.
- Ability to work independently.
- Language skills: Fluent in English (written and spoken); German language skills are a strong advantage.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

#MYCYM

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.occupation: Process Engineer (f/m/d) for GT Auxiliary Systems with SAP expertise (Produktionsingenieur/in)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

You work closely with engineering, suppliers, customers, and cross-functional project teams to deliver gas turbine auxiliary systems. Your day includes creating and updating engineering documentation, supporting project execution activities, and coordinating technical interfaces with internal and external stakeholders. You also contribute to the digitalization of engineering processes, support colleagues using SAP S/4HANA engineering-related modules, and ensure project requirements, quality standards, and supplier deliverables are met throughout the project lifecycle.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Responsibility for customer order engineering activities for gas turbine auxiliary systems
* Creation and maintenance of piping and instrumentation diagrams as well as preparation of engineering documentation, specifications, drawings, data sheets, and parts lists
* Support of data-driven project execution methods and implementation of digitalized engineering processes across multiple teams
* Provision of user support for engineering-related SAP S/4HANA applications and continuous process improvement initiatives
* Coordination of suppliers for engineering and manufacturing activities, including progress monitoring, quality assurance, documentation review, and acceptance inspections
* Clarification and coordination of technical interfaces with customers, suppliers, site personnel, engineering partners, and internal stakeholders

What You Bring

* Degree in process engineering, mechanical engineering, plant engineering, or a comparable engineering discipline, combined with professional experience in project execution
* Experience in at least one relevant engineering field and a strong understanding of engineering project environments
* More than 2 years of experience with SAP S/4HANA, including basic knowledge of Materials Management (MM) and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM)
* Passion for process simplification, automation, digitalization, and openness to new technologies and modern ways of working
* Analytical mindset, structured working approach, and ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks simultaneously
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, very good English language proficiency, and willingness to develop innovative solutions in interdisciplinary teams 

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and 
decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, 
steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, 
modernization, and digitalization of the fleet

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

#LI-KL1

jobs.occupation: Physical Security Specialist - Data Center Security Operations (m/d/f) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed. 
 
The Physical Security Specialist responsible for Data Center Security Operations will support managing and executing daily physical security operations at assigned data centers, ensuring alignment with established policies and procedures. They will support routine site inspections, audits, and physical security system checks to maintain operational readiness and security risk assessments of locations as required.

The Physical Security Specialist will coordinate the activities of contracted security personnel (guard force/maintenance vendors), including scheduling, compliance, and performance monitoring in cooperation with Area Data Center Security Operations Lead, Data Center Management, Data Center Services, Lines of Business and market units. They will support projects of the installation, maintenance, and status of electronic security systems, report technical issues to vendors or IT team as needed. They will assist in case of physical security incidents on-site, including reporting, escalation, and coordination with law enforcement or emergency responders.

The Physical Security Specialist will maintain the highest level of professionalism in all activities to represent the organization internally and externally, while serving as a trusted advisor and ambassador for SAP and affiliated companies.

Competencies and Skills:

- Manage detailed programs related to the efficiency of the financial, operational and overall compliance of the organization.
- Seek to highlight ways to improve the effectiveness of the organization and its processes.
- Possess a good working knowledge and understanding of their industry and identify and collect key market information/trends and apply to the organization/processes.
- Manage and execute day to day delivery of multiple projects up and down the organization.
- Manage relationships often with global, regional and local senior management plus outside service providers and business partners.
- Manage processes and interfaces across organizational boundaries inside and outside of Global Physical Security management that relate to area of responsibility.
- Seek to drive operational excellence and quality assurance by providing best practices, problem solving, and guidance within his / her area of responsibility.  
- There may be occasional travel and responsibilities with in the region, or when required to support operations out side of the prescribed region.Serve as liaison to executive management / provide reports / champion internal goals and manage KPI's. 

Experience, Education, and Certifications:

- Experience in physical security industry or equivalent (military, law enforcement, etc.) or corporate physical security  
- Direct experience in the majority of ”Job Description” and “Competencies and Skills” above.
- A degree in related field (desirable).Ability to pass background verification and Government Security Clearance
- Fluent German speaking with comprehensive English language written and spoken a must.

​

Bring out your best
SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.  

We win with inclusion
SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.

SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. Join our dedicated Customer Service specialists as they independently carry out maintenance and modernization measures for energy transmission networks at our international clients.
